class.name: CSSRule
class.brief_description: A structured handle to a CSS rule in an HTML layout.
class.description: Obtain rules from [method HTMLStyleSheet.get_rules] or [method CSSRule.get_css_rules]. Use [member selector_text] and [member style] for style rules, and [member css_rules] for nested rules. A rule handle becomes invalid when any CSSOM edit changes its stylesheet. CSS edits only affect the current layout and are not saved to source files.

method.name: delete_rule
method.description: Deletes the nested rule at [param index]. Returns [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] for an invalid handle or index, and [constant ERR_UNAUTHORIZED] when editing the default stylesheet.

method.name: get_css_rules
method.description: Returns structured handles to nested rules in this rule's block. The returned array is empty when there are no child rules.

method.name: get_css_text
method.description: Returns the serialized rule text, or an empty string for an invalid handle.

method.name: get_index
method.description: Returns this rule's index within its parent rule list, or [code]-1[/code] for an invalid handle.

method.name: get_name
method.description: Returns the at-rule name without the leading [code]@[/code], or an empty string for qualified rules.

method.name: get_path
method.description: Returns the sequence of zero-based rule indices from the stylesheet root to this rule.

method.name: get_selector_text
method.description: Returns the selector text for a qualified style rule, or an empty string for other rule types.

method.name: get_style
method.description: Returns the declaration block for a qualified style rule or an at-rule with declarations, or [code]null[/code] for other rule types.

method.name: insert_rule
method.description: Inserts a nested rule at the given zero-based index. The parent block must accept nested rules. Editing invalidates existing rule and declaration handles for the stylesheet.

method.name: is_valid
method.description: Returns whether this rule handle still points to the current stylesheet revision.

method.name: set_css_text
method.description: Replaces this rule with parsed [param text]. The edit is ignored for invalid handles and the read-only default stylesheet.

members.member: Nested rules inside this rule's block.
Zero-based index within the parent rule list.
Selector text for a qualified style rule.
Declaration block for a qualified style rule or a supported descriptor at-rule such as [code]@font-face[/code], [code]@page[/code], and [code]@property[/code].
Whether the handle still refers to the current stylesheet revision.
